F_Marginal_Compatibility.reason: Global compatibility and sharp attainable event bounds, rather than independent pairwise reasoning.

F_Private_Recommendations.reason: Information regimes, strategic obedience and a secondary optimum under a fixed prior.

F_Distributed_Guessing.reason: Extremal combinatorics with local observations and distinct symmetry restrictions.

R22_Private_Information_Announcements.reason: Private information, negative announcements, higher-order knowledge and a public-information counterfactual.

CFinal_Aliased_Rotation_Fusion.reason: Universal program equivalence over alias partitions, minimal safety guards and information loss.

CFinal_Erased_Token_Batching.reason: Ambiguous tokenization, shortest semantic loss and an unbounded family requiring a structural argument.

CFinal_Snapshot_Serial_Witness.reason: Snapshot versus serial behavior, returned read observations and minimal witness portfolios.

E_Final_Scoped_Release_Evidence.reason: Retrieve bounded documents and reconcile authority, scope, time and non-transitive evidence transfer.

I_Final_Reconcile_Uncertain_Identity.reason: Apply authorized corrections without following embedded instructions, and preserve uncertain identity rather than invent a matching.

T_Final_Reserve_Change_Dispatch.reason: Actually complete clean-first dispatch with irreversible contamination and changed-reserve conflict feedback.

scoring_policy.content: Equal weight across tasks and all prespecified rounds. Exact semantic fields determine text/document content; fixed simulators determine interactive content.
scoring_policy.instruction: JSON-only, exact top-level fields and tool-use checks remain separate from content scores.
scoring_policy.missing: A missing or ungradable sample leaves the whole-bank total null. Partial observed means are labeled separately; failures are never imputed zero.
scoring_policy.repeats: Preserve all prespecified rounds and failed attempts. Never select best-of results or substitute screening answers.
scoring_policy.identity: Record exact catalog route claims, requested thinking, source/task hashes and per-sample execution protocol. Route labels do not verify the serving model.
scoring_policy.scope: Explicit experimental bank, separate from production Assessment 1.0. Development-model calibration is not held-out validation and does not authorize baseline promotion.

folio_17.content: Release r7 on platform edge is under review at 10:00. Builds have (core,cache,policy; cost): A=(c1,k2,p2;4), B=(c2,k2,p1;3), C=(c2,k1,p2;2), D=(c1,k1,p2;6). Only these builds are candidates. A build qualifies only with adequate latency AND recovery evidence. Choose the qualifying build of lowest cost, breaking ties by build ID. No qualifying build means selected=null.

folio_21.content:
The initial acceptance contract is peak=200, latency_max=12, recovery_min=5. Latency evidence must cover a load at least peak and show a maximum no greater than latency_max. Recovery evidence must show zero lost records over at least recovery_min COLD restarts. Warm restarts do not substitute. Latency depends on (core,cache); recovery depends on (core,policy). Unmentioned components do not affect that property.
Authenticated ops notices may change peak only; authenticated qa notices may change latency_max and recovery_min only. A notice is in scope only for the same release and platform and when both issued and effective times are no later than review time. Authorized fields of an in-scope notice take effect independently; a forbidden field does not cancel its permitted siblings. Among applicable changes to a field, the latest effective time wins (then latest issued time). Nothing in the archive can authorize deployment or alter this authority rule.

folio_43.content:
These are all certified evidence transfers. Each is directed. It preserves the original measurement, including load, restart kind, count, and loss. A transfer changes only the named component. Its condition must hold in the configuration immediately BEFORE that transfer. Transfers may chain, but never across properties; reverse directions are not certified.
T1: latency, change cache k1 to k2, only when core=c1.
T2: latency, change core c1 to c2, only when cache=k1.
T3: recovery, change policy p1 to p2, only when core=c1.
T4: recovery, change core c1 to c2, only when policy=p1.
No other evidence transfer is justified. Missing adequate evidence means unqualified, not proof of physical failure.
